verdict.rationale: Azure is a cloud platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms an official Microsoft MCP server is documented at github.com/microsoft/mcp, but the pack has no detail on its Azure tool coverage, setup, auth flow or real-world agent use. Missing for 10: documentation of the Azure-specific tools and resources the server exposes, setup and authentication guidance for connecting an agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.
